output.subject: Request to review the rejection of claim for Right Total Knee Replacement
output.facts: The patient was admitted on October 20, 2026, for treatment of Primary osteoarthritis, right knee, and underwent a Right total knee replacement. Suraksha Health Insurance Co. rejected the claim on November 4, 2026, citing the pre-existing disease waiting period.

items.argument: The insurer rejected the claim for Right Total Knee Replacement, citing the pre-existing disease waiting period. However, as per policy clause 5.1, expenses related to a pre-existing disease are covered after the waiting period stated in the Policy Schedule. The policy schedule specifies a 36-month waiting period for Osteoarthritis of the knee. The patient has completed 40 months of continuous coverage, which exceeds the 36-month waiting period. Furthermore, IRDAI guidelines on pre-existing diseases cap the maximum waiting period at 36 months. Therefore, the rejection of the claim on this ground is incorrect, and the amount of {{flag.WAITING_REJECTION_INVALID.recoverable}} should be paid.

output.relief: We request Suraksha Health Insurance Co. to review this claim decision, approve the claim, and remit the recoverable amount of {{totals.recoverable}}. We expect a written resolution to this grievance within 15 days, as per insurer grievance resolution timelines.
